name: stand_rl
title: Stand (RL specialist: hold a still two-leg stand, BATON-blendable)
summary: The RL stand specialist: a policy trained in one 400-iter burst against a CONSTANT stand ghost (unitree-default pose == the walker's nominal), in the SAME LSTM+REF_OBS obs family as the walker, so BATON only swaps weights + reference tables. Dead-still (|roll| 0.02 deg, |vx| 0.00) -- 38x stiller than a velocity-conditioned monolith's stand. This is the BATON pause/hold state between locomotion segments. Distinct from the deterministic 'balance_two_legs' core (kind=deterministic) which is the shipped static-stand/push-recovery path.

ghost.notes: Constant unitree-default pose, arms v3 hang, level attitude. Validator WARNs (it is walk-calibrated; a constant lut trips symmetry/clearance rules -- motion-class awareness is a validator TODO).

baton.notes: Constant-ghost cyclic member (nb 64) so it blends with walk/carry. It IS the stand attractor -- a locomotion specialist must enter COLD after standing here. Course/schedule keyword: stand.

train.notes: One 400-iter burst at HARNESS_LAM0=0.9, same era/arch/obs as the flagship walker (seeds 0.945-0.950). VERIFY frozen bundle before re-training; memory project_baton_policy_switching (Shipped section).

specialist.note: Emitted as a BATON_SPECIALISTS entry (mode|checkpoint|ghost_lut|vx) with vx=0.

verification.result: Dead-still stand phases in the box-delivery sequence (vx 0.00, roll 0.001, z 0.778), 0 falls across all switches.
